_comment: DECLARATIVE MODEL REGISTRY — the single source of truth that maps (backend, capability) descriptors to concrete model IDs. Code and config (pd-fleet.yml, lib/*, cli/*) MUST declare INTENT — a backend + a capability like 'cheap' or 'max-thinking' — and resolve the real ID through lib/model-registry.ts at the last second. Never hardcode a model ID anywhere else; it is as ephemeral as a secret. This file is refreshed per version build by scripts/refresh-model-registry.ts (provider /models APIs + web search). The no-hardcoded-model-ids guard test allowlists ONLY this file + the cost-rate table + ID-keyed data tables (catalog, context-window, benchmark). Every ID below is prefix-priced in lib/cost-tracker.ts so the fail-closed telemetry policy admits it.
generatedBy: manual seed — scripts/refresh-model-registry.ts rewrites this per build
source: reconciled from lib/backend-telemetry-policy.ts DEFAULT_OPERATOR_* (the 'cheap' row) + lib/fleet-engine.ts FLEET_MODEL_TIERS (the mid/high rows) at 2026-06-15; all IDs verified cost-priced

capabilities.cheap: fastest + cheapest competent tier; the default for fleet ships and bulk work
capabilities.balanced: mid tier; good quality at moderate cost
capabilities.high: high-end; for landing decisions, novel attack construction, hard reasoning
capabilities.max-thinking: frontier max-reasoning tier; reserve for the hardest problems
capabilities.code: code-specialized model where the provider has one (else the general high pick)
